content.value: Classification derived from branch -> PR -> main for all 71 open children (2 are drafts.* DRAFT TWINS of published rows also in the list, so distinct open tasks = 69, not 71 — the gauge counts a draft revision as work). 13 are PROOF-UNSTAMPED (PR merged, only lead/live criteria open). 6 are CODE-MISSING-ON-MAIN (PR open). 1 has a CLOSED-UNMERGED PR (#10014, a dead pointer that still reads as an owner — the census's own comment warns about exactly this). 11 never started. 1 has NO CRITERIA AT ALL (0/0 — can never be met or unmet). 18 name a branch with no PR, and for 15 of those the branch has NO REMOTE HEAD EITHER: the bytes exist only in deleted worktrees. THE DECISIVE COUNTEREXAMPLE: dr-w10-s1-verdict-reads-the-deploy-rate is 12/13 with only a merge-gated criterion open, and deploys_failing — the verdict word the whole slice exists to emit — appears on origin/main ONLY in the charter and two ledger .md files. ZERO code. N-1/N is a STAMPING ARTEFACT, not a delivery signal. AND dr-w24-bl-emit-commit-distance-on-the-fleet-row is NOT closable: it is 1/3, not 3/3 — criterion 2's per-struct pin does not exist and criterion 3 names @schema_allowlist, an identifier that exists NOWHERE on main (dr-w24-s4's schema arm never landed). Closing it today would be a fabricated done. ONE ROW IS PROVABLY CLOSABLE: dr-w19-s1-unblock-10518-census-rebase (7/8) — PR #10518 merged 2026-08-07T23:35:24Z; close with previous_worker epic-builder-pr-10518-stops-being-blocke... epoch 5. 19 rows name no branch and are UNCLASSIFIED. The FALSE-DONE suspicion is REFUTED: zero of 72 done rows have met criteria with empty evidence, and the 2026-08-07T23:0x sweep was a status reconciliation, not a fabrication. Prior art: cch-w49-s5 already built this exact shape in another epic — reuse it.
